taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Approved wallet transfer version and per-currency balanced postings
controls.source_trace: Bind the approved transfer intent to sender wallet, recipient, amount and currency through execution, including limits and account state.
controls.implementation_branch: Confirm that transfer approval covers the immutable amount, currency, sender and destination actually posted. Pending, failed and reversed ledger entries are not final spendable credit. A cross-currency display mismatch needs authoritative posting evidence, and the sandbox must never represent actual customer funds.
controls.operational_method: Use signed minor-unit postings per currency. For a same-currency synthetic transfer with fee, debit from sender must equal recipient credit plus fee postings; held funds are not yet final credit. For exchange, record the approved rate/version and both currency ledgers rather than adding unlike units. Bind postings to the approved transfer version and link reversals to original entries; a retry must not generate a second independent credit under the same one-use policy.
controls.controlled_verification: Record synthetic held/posted per-currency entries for one approved transfer, including fee or FX terms when applicable. Compare valid one-use posting with a changed approved-version tuple and a duplicate delivery/reversal; inspect both debit and credit sides.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A pending transfer ID or altered client summary is not a posted unauthorized transfer; inspect both ledger sides.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind approved intent to atomic debits/credits and verify legitimate retries plus rejected substitutions.
